world.description: a pencil logistics and supply network

world.label: Pencil Supply Network
world.summary: Specialists produce, process, assemble, transport, and sell pencils through a recurring supply network.

actions.description: Harvest logs for the pencil supply network.
Process logs into pencil slats at the sawmill.
Add mined graphite to the graphite supplier's stock.
Assemble pencils from slats, graphite, and erasers.
Carry pencils from the factory to the shop.
Sell pencils from the shop to a customer.

mechanics.rationale: The timber supplier harvests logs into its own stock.

checks.label: the forest crew is the timber supplier

limits: Harvesting adds logs to the acting timber supplier; it does not make slats.
tests: The Forest crew can harvest logs and its log stock increases by one.
An actor with another role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Timber supplier role identifies the log harvester.
Harvested logs are represented by the acting entity's log stock.

mechanics.rationale: The sawmill converts one log held by the named source into one slat held by the sawmill.

checks.label: the sawmill is the slat maker
the log source has a log

limits: One log is consumed for each slat made.
The source must match the timber supplier category and have a log.
tests: The Sawmill can use a log held by the Forest crew to make one slat.
The action is refused when the source has no logs.
An actor that is not a slat maker is refused.
semantic_bindings: Slat maker role limits this action to the sawmill step.
The source's log inventory is the material consumed.
The sawmill's slat inventory is the product made.

mechanics.rationale: The graphite supplier adds mined graphite to its own stock.

checks.label: the graphite mine is the graphite supplier

limits: This action supplies graphite only to the acting graphite supplier.
tests: The Graphite mine can supply graphite and its stock increases by one.
An actor with another role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Graphite supplier role identifies the source of supplied graphite.
Supplied graphite is represented in the actor's graphite inventory.

mechanics.rationale: The eraser supplier makes erasers for pencil production and adds them to its stock.

checks.label: the eraser works is the eraser supplier

limits: This action makes erasers only for the acting eraser supplier.
tests: The Eraser works can make an eraser and its stock increases by one.
An actor with another role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Eraser supplier role limits eraser production to its designated step.
Made erasers are represented in the actor's eraser inventory.

mechanics.rationale: The pencil assembler consumes one slat, one graphite unit, and one eraser from the named sources and makes one pencil.

checks.label: the factory worker is the pencil assembler
the slat source has a slat
the graphite source has graphite
the eraser source has an eraser

limits: Each named source must match its specialist category and hold the required component.
One of each component is consumed to make one pencil.
tests: The Pencil factory can assemble a pencil when the named sources each hold the required component.
The action is refused if any required component is absent.
A worker with a different role is refused.
semantic_bindings: The pencil assembler role identifies the assembly step.
The named slat, graphite, and eraser inventories provide the consumed materials.
The factory's pencil inventory records the assembled product.

mechanics.rationale: The carrier moves one pencil from the named source stock to the named destination stock.

checks.label: the worker is the supply carrier
the pencil source has a pencil
the source is the pencil factory
the destination is the pencil shop

limits: This action transfers one pencil from the pencil factory to the pencil shop.
The actor's inventory is not treated as cargo.
tests: The carrier can move one pencil from the Pencil factory to the Pencil shop when the factory has stock.
The action is refused when the factory has no pencils or when either endpoint is not the specified facility.
A worker with a different role is refused.
semantic_bindings: Carrier role limits the action to transport.
Pencil stock is subtracted from the source and added to the destination.
The action description identifies the factory and shop as the route endpoints.

mechanics.rationale: The retailer transfers one pencil from the shop to the named customer.

checks.label: the shop worker is the retailer
the shop has a pencil

limits: One pencil is transferred per sale.
The customer must match the customer category.
tests: The Pencil shop can sell one pencil to the School when it has stock.
The action is refused when the shop has no pencils.
An actor that is not a retailer is refused.
semantic_bindings: Retailer role identifies the selling step.
Shop pencil stock is transferred to the named customer's pencil stock.

processes.rationale: Logs renew at the timber source so log harvesting can continue.
Mined graphite renews at the graphite supplier so graphite supply can continue.
Erasers renew at their supplier so the component supply can continue.

readout.title: How coordination slowed (the four mechanisms of the Waltzman paper)
readout.summary: The simulation shows a repeated pencil-production and delivery cycle: the forest crew, graphite mine and eraser works supply materials, the pencil factory assembles pencils, the carrier moves them, and the pencil shop sells them to the school. No events show coordination disputes or delays; the recorded actions proceed routinely.

mechanisms.name: Reopened settled issues
mechanisms.missing_reason: No settled issue or approval is recorded as undone or reopened.
